dedupe_keys.name: research data for a two stage resilient restoration framework for large scale urban electric power infrastructure systems under extreme hurricane events considering social vulnerability and economic factors

description: Research Data for "A Two-Stage Resilient Restoration Framework for Large-Scale Urban Electric Power Infrastructure Systems under Extreme Hurricane Events Considering Social Vulnerability and Economic Factors is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Hiuluk Yam, Shuo Li (Tianjin University College of Management and Economics). This repository contains the research data accompanying the study “A Two-Stage Resilient Restoration Framework for Large-Scale Urban Electric Power Infrastructure Systems under Extreme Hurricane Events Considering Social Vulnerability and Economic Factors.” The dataset is organized into two main parts: hurricane hazard data and synthetic power distribution network data for large-scale urban electric power infrastructure systems. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
